The single action on a screen, in two looks.

**When to use.** One primary Button per screen ("See trips"). Use `variant="secondary"` for a lower-weight action next to it ("Sign out").

**What you provide.** `children` (the label) and `onClick`. `variant` is `"primary"` (default) or `"secondary"`.

**Rules.** Minimum height 44px (`touch-target`). Label is `button-label` (16px, weight 500). Corners are `radius-md`. Primary is `white` on `brand`; secondary is `brand` text and border on `white`.
